solution_design.project_name: Kaggle Telco Customer Churn Reduction System
solution_design.business_objective: Predict and prevent customer churn to safeguard $1.45M in annual recurring revenue.
solution_design.target_definition: Binary classification: Churn = 'Yes' (1) within the next billing cycle vs 'No' (0).
solution_design.primary_metric: PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under Curve) to prioritize high-precision intervention on imbalanced target.
operational_constraints: Zero data leakage across cross-validation splits
Explainable root-cause attribution for frontline retention agents
solution_design.champion_model_architecture: Leakage-free Scikit-Learn Pipeline combining StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, and Tuned RandomForest / LogisticRegression.

decomposition.formula: Net ARR = Beginning ARR + Expansion ARR - Churned ARR

assumptions.assumption: Target intervention cost is $90 per customer ($15/mo discount for 6 months).
assumptions.sensitivity: Moderate: A $20/mo discount reduces campaign ROI by 14% but increases retention rate.

assumptions.assumption: 45% of targeted high-risk customers accept retention offer and remain for at least 12 months.
assumptions.source: Empirical A/B test results (35.5% relative churn reduction)
assumptions.sensitivity: High: If effectiveness falls below 22%, the proactive campaign fails to break even.

assumptions.assumption: MonthlyCharges * 12 reflects accurate forward-looking annual value without churn.
assumptions.sensitivity: Low: Tenure reconciliation confirmed median variance < 3%.

core_questions_to_answer: Which customer segments are driving the majority of churn?
Can we reliably identify high-risk churners at least 30 days in advance?
What proactive interventions provide the highest positive ROI?
acceptance_criteria: Model achieves PR-AUC >= 0.60 on holdout validation data.
Explainable top 3 churn risk drivers delivered with every predicted probability.
Proactive campaign ROI exceeds 100% net of intervention costs.

analysis_plan.phase_1: Business Understanding: Formulate KPIs, metric tree, and requirements (Completed)
analysis_plan.phase_2: Data Understanding: Profile data, assess quality, map schema, reconcile charges
analysis_plan.phase_3: Data Preparation: Zero-leakage cleaning, feature engineering, handle imbalanced classes
analysis_plan.phase_4: Modeling: Train, tune, and cross-validate Scikit-Learn pipelines
analysis_plan.phase_5: Evaluation: Evaluate PR/ROC curves, cohorts, root cause, A/B test, GenAI evaluation
analysis_plan.phase_6: Deployment & Observability: Executive summary, dashboard specs, drift monitoring
